device: Linux cloud VM, headless. Not a physical iPad or Daniel's tablet.

method.touch: Real touch events. Chromium: CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent. WebKit: protocol Input.dispatchTouchEvent. Not mouse wheel.
method.eventClickToNextPaint: Event Timing API duration of the click entry (input timestamp through the next paint after handlers and rAF). durationThreshold 0. Null when the browser records no click entry.
method.pointerDownToDoubleRaf: performance.now() at pointerdown until the second requestAnimationFrame after the watched DOM value changes. This is about one frame later than first paint and includes woAutoFit when that work is queued as rAF during the click.
method.handlerExecution: Time inside the wrapped play-mode function only. This is not the visible result.
method.acceptanceTargetsAreNotMeasurements: Targets in the design doc are goals, not descriptions of this run.
